criteria.title: Build init and a bounded shell against the custom ABI rather than hosted libc.
criteria.task: Implement the64-byte shell buffer and explicit overflow/reset policy using only the CMK ABI. Specify whether capacity includes terminator; test empty line, maximum accepted line, overlong line followed by help and partial input across reads.
criteria.purpose: A bounded array alone does not define safe framing or recovery after overflow.
